meaning:
A womanof the tribe of Judah living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.2.26; married to Jerahmeel (H3396);
mother of: Onam (H0208H)
§ Atarah = "a crown"
wife of Jerahmeel and mother of Onam

elsewhere.note: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.
